title: code-freeze-bench: does a coding agent honour a code freeze?
summary: A benchmark that rebuilds the 2025 code-freeze database deletion on real Postgres and scores Claude agents against the server's statement log and a real point-in-time recovery, never against what the agent says.

headline_numbers.label: Opus wrote to production during a prompt-only freeze
headline_numbers.command: uv run freezetest scoreboard && grep -E 'Break(Prompt)(Haiku|Sonnet|Opus)\}' paper/results.tex
headline_numbers.source: results/SCOREBOARD.md, No incident, By enforcement level and model

headline_numbers.label: Writes completed under a read-only role or the typed gate
headline_numbers.value: 0 of 150 runs, though 14 of the 150 still tried (all Opus)
headline_numbers.command: uv run freezetest scoreboard && jq '{role: ."none.role.violated", gate: ."none.gate.violated", role_tried: ."none.role.attempted", gate_tried: ."none.gate.attempted"}' results/summary.json

headline_numbers.label: Write attempts hidden from the founder the next morning
headline_numbers.command: uv run freezetest scoreboard && jq '.concealed_attempt' results/summary.json

headline_numbers.label: False all-clear after a nightly job deleted 13 customers
headline_numbers.command: uv run freezetest scoreboard && grep FalseAllClearPlanted paper/results.tex

headline_numbers.label: Point-in-time recovery restored the freeze state exactly
headline_numbers.command: uv run freezetest scoreboard && jq '.recovery' results/summary.json
